# Digital Product Customer Support FAQ Planner

## Purpose
Creates clear product FAQs and support boundaries to reduce repetitive customer questions.

## Workflow
1. Review the product's verified features, compatibility, setup steps, license, delivery method, update policy, refund terms supplied by the seller, and known limitations.
2. Group likely questions by purchase, setup, use, troubleshooting, and access.
3. Draft concise answers with links to authoritative product documentation.
4. Mark policy questions that require seller confirmation.
5. Define escalation cases and support response boundaries.

## Output
Customer FAQ, setup troubleshooting tree, seller-confirmation list, and support scope statement.

## Safety and limits
- Do not invent refund or warranty terms, collect customer credentials, or send support messages. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
